info.description:
## Anchanto Order Management System (SelluSeller) Open API

Unified specification consolidating all SelluSeller OMS Open API endpoints:
- **Order Management:** Single and asynchronous order creation, lifecycle transitions, status updates, invoices, and cancellations.
- **Inventory Management:** Stock balance queries, v1 & v2 absolute/delta stock updates, and warehouse stock location mappings.
- **Catalogue & Taxonomy:** Product listings, prices, images, kit mappings, brands, categories, and attributes.
- **Distribution Orders (Distro):** Bulk fulfillment, package management, pickup timeslots, and return management.
- **Shipping & Carriers:** Shipping methods, carrier tracking, and SMP marketplace carrier mappings.
- **Store Integrations:** Store credentials, metadata sync timestamps, and marketplace connections.
- **Outbound Webhooks:** Real-time event notifications published by OMS on order lifecycle, shipment details, and inventory changes.

post.description: OAuth2 authorization_code grant against SelluSeller/OMS. Called during the SelluSeller app-install callback. All parameters travel in a JSON request body (Content-Type: application/json, Accept: */*) - NOT in the query string and NOT form-urlencoded. The body is a POJO handed to restManager.post(url, headers, dto, JsonNode.class), so Jackson serialisation applies and @JsonProperty wins: client_id, client_secret, grant_type, code, redirect_uri. grant_type is injected from the ${GRANT_TYPE} property, which is 'authorization_code' in every environment properties file. JPluger reads only 'access_token' out of the response. Calling modules: marketplace-connector (connector/marketplace-connector/src/main/java/com/anchanto/connector/marketplace/publisher/AuthenticationService.java:140-153), wms-connector (connector/wms-connector/src/main/java/com/anchanto/connector/wms/publisherService/AuthenticationService.java:126-134), marketplace-core (marketplace-integrations/marketplace-core/src/main/java/com/anchanto/marketplace/core/service/AuthenticationService.java:226-247), carrier-integration (carrier-integration/src/main/java/com/anchanto/carrier/integration/service/AuthenticationService.java:134-154).

post.description: NOT multipart/form-data - despite the 'upload' in the path this is a plain application/json POST. CatalogueProductField.description: Gson view of ProductFieldDTO / ProductFieldTO. TRAP: @JsonProperty says attributeCode/attributeValue but the Java fields are attribute_code/attribute_value and Gson wins.

CatalogueResponseCategory.description: integration-standards catalogue CategoryDTO as embedded in a catalogue response - different shape from the request-side CatalogueCategory.

CatalogueResponseImage.description: integration-standards catalogue ImageDTO - the response-side image, much richer than the request-side CatalogueImage.

CatalogueStatusUpdateRequest.description: Gson view of marketplace-connector CatalogueStatusUpdateRequestDTO / selluseller-connector CatalogueStatusUpdateTO. Raw field names win over @JsonProperty("storeCode"/"productCode").

CatalogueStore.description: integration-standards catalogue StoreDTO as embedded in a catalogue response (extra_details=true).

CatalogueWarehouseStock.description: Gson view of marketplace-connector WarehouseStockDTO. TRAP: @JsonProperty says warehouseCode/marketplaceStock but the Java fields are marketplace_warehouse_id/warehouse_stock - Gson emits the field names.

CategoryAttribute.description: Response row for a category attribute (CategoryAttributesResponseDTO / PayloadCategoryAttibutesTO). Most fields are typed String in the DTO even where they read as booleans, and both `mandatory` and `is_mandatory` are returned.

CategoryAttributeRequest.description: Gson view of CategoryAttributesDTO: every @JsonProperty is ignored, so the wire keys are the raw snake_case Java field names - note field_criteria (not 'criteria') and field_parent_id on the request side, whereas the response uses criteria and parent_id.

CategoryResponse.description: From CreateCategoryResponseTO / UpdateCategoryResponseTO. The update response carries no id or display_name.

CategorySummary.description: Row of GET /rest/v1/categories, from PayloadCategoryTO. Every field is typed String in the DTO, including the boolean-looking ones.

CommonErrorResponse.description: Error envelope returned by OMS. The OAuth endpoint uses the RFC 6749 error/error_description pair; the /rest/v1 endpoints use status/message/summary and sometimes an errors array. error.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. invalid_grant, invalid_token, unprocessable_entity.

status.description: HTTP status echoed in the body.

CreateBrandRequest.description: Gson view of CreateBrandRequestDTO. The legacy connectors' Jackson path would instead emit storeCode.

CreateCategoryAttributesRequest.description: Gson view of CreateCategoryAttributesRequestDTO, shared by POST /rest/v1/category_attributes and POST /rest/v1/bulk_categories_attributes.

DiscrepancyReportRequest.description: Gson view of DiscrepancyReportDTO; every field carries @SerializedName. Exactly one of support_bulk_import_id / report_history_id is populated.

DiscrepancyReportResponse.description: Read as a raw JsonNode by JPluger, so no DTO pins the shape.

FieldValue.description: One selectable option of an attribute (FieldValueDTO / FieldValueTO).

InventoryAsyncApiResponse.description: Jackson-deserialized AsyncApiResponseDTO. Feed id is used to poll async feed processing.

InventoryAsyncCreateProduct.description: Gson view of wms-connector CreateInventoryProductDTO - every field has an explicit snake_case @SerializedName that overrides the camelCase @JsonProperty.

InventoryAsyncCreateRequest.description: Gson view of wms-connector AsyncCreateInventoryRequestDTO (@SerializedName("inventory_products")); mirrored by wms-integration-core CreateInventoryProductsRequestDTO.

InventoryAsyncStockInventory.description: wms-connector InventoryDTO - note quantity is a STRING here, unlike the selluseller-connector InventoryTO where it is an int.

InventoryAsyncStockUpdateRequest.description: Gson view of wms-connector InventoryStockUpdateRequestDTO. Outer levels carry only @JsonProperty (so the Gson names happen to match: product / skus / sku); SkuDTO adds @SerializedName for seller_sku and force_sync.

InventoryBulkUpdateProduct.description: Gson view of wms-connector UpdateInventoryProductDTO (@SerializedName everywhere).

InventoryBulkUpdateRequest.description: Gson view of wms-connector BulkUpdateInventoryRequestDTO. payload_type is left null by the constructor used at WmsProductServiceImpl.java:138 and Gson therefore omits it.

InventoryBulkUpdateResponse.description: wms-connector BulkUpdateInventoryResponseDTO (Jackson). success must be true for the connector to consider the call successful.

InventoryCatalogueAttributes.description: wms-connector InventoryCatalogueAttributeDTO - the catalogue side-effect payload of an inventory create/update when create_or_update_catalogue is true.

InventoryDeltaStockError.description: DeltaStockResponse. transactionId and docType are set locally by the connector and are NOT part of the OMS body.

InventoryErrorResponse.description: OMS OIP error envelope. selluseller-connector reads errors[0].message (CataloguesServiceExtendedImpl.java:430) and DeltaStockUpdateResponse binds the same `errors` array.

InventoryEventParameters.description: Gson view of selluseller-connector EventParametersDTO. Every field carries @JsonProperty only, so Gson emits the raw camelCase Java names.

InventoryProductCreateRequest.description: Gson view of selluseller-connector InventoryProductTO. @JsonProperty is IGNORED here because the HttpEntity is round-tripped through Gson; wire keys are the raw Java field names, except dynamicFields which is renamed by @SerializedName("dynamic_fields"). Nulls are omitted.

InventoryProductDynamicField.description: selluseller-connector InventoryProductDynamicFieldDTO and wms-connector DynamicFieldDTO share this @SerializedName shape.

InventoryProductListResponse.description: GET /rest/v1/inventory_products body. Bound as GetInventoryProductsResponseTO (selluseller-connector) or GetInventoryProductsResponse (wms-integration-core).

InventoryProductPayload.description: Union of selluseller-connector PayloadTO and wms-integration-core InventoryDataDTO (the WMS view adds reserve, material_type and the three quantity totals).

InventoryProductUpdateWrappedRequest.description: Gson view of CreateInventoryProductRequestTO; used by InventoryProductServiceExtendedImpl.java:346 on the PATCH-by-id path.

InventoryStockItem.description: marketplace-core-model GetStockDTO. NOTE `marketplaceCategoryCode` is genuinely camelCase on the wire - the Java field is marketplace_category_code but @JsonProperty("marketplaceCategoryCode") wins on this Jackson-bound response.

InventoryStockLocationCreateRequest.description: selluseller-connector CreateInventoryProductStockLocationRequestTO. No live call site - shape taken from the DTO.

InventoryStockLocationUpdateResponse.description: selluseller-connector UpdateInventoryProductStockLocationResponseTO - identical to the create response minus `id`.

InventoryStockSkus.description: selluseller-connector SkusTO; its additionalProperties map is transient and never emitted.

InventoryStockUpdateRequest.description: Gson view of selluseller-connector UpdateInventoryProductStockRequestTO. TRAP: the event-parameters field has @JsonProperty("event_parameters") but no @SerializedName, so Gson writes the raw Java field name `eventParametersDTO`. `additionalProperties` is transient and never emitted.

InventoryV2Inventory.description: One warehouse's quantity. Gson wire names.

quantity.description: No @SerializedName; raw field name is already `quantity`

ManifestOrderItem.description: Gson view of ManifestOrderItemRequestDTO. line_item_id is declared transient and therefore never serialised; only line_item_ids reaches OMS.

line_item_ids.description: Unpacked from the incoming itemCodes list.

ManifestUploadRequest.description: Gson view of UpdateManifestRequestDTO. Sent as application/json - this endpoint is NOT multipart/form-data; the manifest artefact travels as the `document` string.

document.description: URL of (or base64 payload for) the manifest document.

ManifestUploadResponse.description: From UpdateManifestReponseDTO. JPluger branches on `success` before flipping order statuses.

client_secret.description: From the ${CLIENT_SECERET} property (misspelling is in the source).

grant_type.description: From the ${GRANT_TYPE} property; every environment sets authorization_code.

code.description: Temporary authorization code from the SelluSeller install callback.

created_at.description: Unix epoch seconds at which the token was issued.

OrderAcknowledgeEntry.description: Gson view of OrderAcknowledgeRequestDTO; all keys from @SerializedName.

OrderApproveOrRejectItem.description: Gson view of ApproveOrRejectOrderItemRequestDTO; raw field names.

OrderAsyncApiResponse.description: Jackson view of AsyncApiResponseDTO returned by the async feed endpoints.

OrderAsyncCreateRequest.description: Gson-serialized body of AsyncCreateOrderRequest. Single key `orders` (raw field name).

OrderCancelItem.description: Gson view of CancelledOrderItemRequestDTO. `id` has no annotation so the raw field name is used; item_quantity and item_codes come from @SerializedName (the @JsonProperty names quantity / itemCodes are NOT on the wire).

OrderCancelRequest.description: Gson view of CancelledOrderRequestDTO (marketplace-connector) merged with the wms-connector variant which additionally sends cancellation_reason.

OrderCompleteRequest.description: Gson view of CompleteOrderRequestDTO; all raw field names (no @SerializedName anywhere on this DTO).

id.description: Order number (field is named id but carries the order number).

OrderConfirmPaymentRequest.description: INFERRED. No live call site exists for /rest/v1/orders/{id}/confirm_payment, so no DTO could be read; the shape mirrors the sibling order-mutation bodies.

OrderCreateErrorResponse.description: Jackson view of CreateOrderErrorResponseDTO, the 409 / 400 duplicate-order body. OrderCreateRequest.description: Gson-serialized body of CreateOrderRequestDTO. Single key `order` (raw field name).

OrderCustomerAddress.description: Gson view of CustomerAddressDTO; raw snake_case field names except additional_addresses (@SerializedName).

OrderDetail.description: Jackson view of the full OMS order document (wms-integrations-legacy DataDTO / marketplace-core-model OrderDataDTO). All keys are @JsonProperty values.

OrderEngravingDetails.description: Gson view of EngravingDetailsDTO; all keys from @SerializedName.

OrderErrorResponse.description: Shared error envelope for the Orders domain. OMS returns `error` on both error status codes and, for some endpoints, on 2xx bodies; wms-connector's OrderAcknowledgeResponseDTO additionally accepts `error_message` via @JsonAlias.

status.description: HTTP status echoed in the body.

OrderEventParameters.description: Free-form EventParametersDTO carried on the cancelled-order stock update.

OrderExtraData.description: Gson view of OrderExtraDataDTO; raw field names sku and data.

OrderExtraField.description: Gson view of OrderExtraFieldDTO; raw field names key_name and key_value.

OrderItemsListEntry.description: Jackson view of OrderLineItems (ss-connector and selluseller-connector, identical classes).

OrderItemsListResponse.description: Jackson view of OrderItemResponseTO returned by GET /rest/v1/orders/{id}/order_items.

OrderPudoDetails.description: Gson view of PudoDetailsDTO; keys from @SerializedName.

isExchange.description: Raw field name isExchange; Gson emits it verbatim.

OrderReturnCreateRequest.description: Gson view of ReturnOrderRequestDTO; all raw field names (@JsonProperty camelCase values describe the inbound Kafka payload only).

OrderRevertSellerCancellationItem.description: Gson view of RevertSellerCancellationOrderItemRequestDTO. Raw field name item_id (the @JsonProperty value `id` is NOT on the wire).

OrderSerialValidationRequest.description: Gson view of UpdateSerialValidationStatusDTO; all keys from @SerializedName.

OrderShippingDetailsRequest.description: Gson view of CreateShippingDetailsRequestDTO; single @SerializedName key shipping_details.

wms_status.description: Only present on the wms-connector variant.

orderNumber.description: Emitted by selluseller-connector (raw field name, no @SerializedName).

OrderUpdateCancelledStockItem.description: Gson view of CancelledItemDTO; raw field names line_item_id, sellable, damaged.

OrderUpdateCancelledStockResponse.description: Response body of update_cancelled_order_stock. selluseller-connector reads it as a raw String and only inspects the status code.

OrderUpdateDetailsPayload.description: Gson view of UpdateOrderDetailsDTO. Wire keys are the raw field names — note the two camelCase ones isOrderItemChange and orderNumber, which Gson emits verbatim because they have no @SerializedName. Only order_extra_data is renamed by @SerializedName.

OrderUpdateDetailsRequest.description: Gson view of UpdateOrderDetailsRequestDTO; single raw field name `order`.

OrderUpdateResponse.description: Jackson view of OrderUpdateResponseDTO extends BaseOrderResponseDTO<OrderItemUpdateResponseDTO>. Used by cancel, mark_complete, update_status, mark_approve_or_reject, revert_seller_cancellation and acknowledge_orders. The item list arrives under `line_items`.

error.description: Non-null even on 2xx bodies for some failures; every caller checks it.

OrderWithholdObject.description: Gson view of WithHoldObject; keys from @SerializedName.

PromotionFailureReasonsRequest.description: Inferred - no DTO exists for this constant-only endpoint.

update_status.description: String in the DTO, not a boolean.

supportReturnOrder.description: Raw Java field name; Gson does not rename it.

SmpShippingMethodRequest.description: Body of POST /rest/v1/smp_shipping_methods. The envelope key is the raw field name of SmpShippingMethodDTO.

SmpShippingMethodSummary.description: Row of the SMP list/create responses (smpshippingcarrier/PayloadTO).

Store.description: One OMS store row. Union of PayloadTO (selluseller-connector) and StoreResponseDTO (wms-integration-core); the WMS DTO adds marketplace_code, state, branch_code and is_global_marketplace.

inventory_sync.description: Always set to 'now' by the caller.

Transaction.description: Gson view of TransactionDTO; every field except `amount` carries @SerializedName, and `amount` keeps its field name.

UpdateBrandRequest.description: From UpdateBrandRequestTO (Jackson names). No live call site.

UpdateCategoryRequest.description: From UpdateCategoryRequestTO (Jackson names). No live call site.

UpdateSmpShippingMethodRequest.description: From UpdatesmpShippingCarrierRequestTO (Jackson names). No live call site.

UpdateStoreSyncTimeRequest.description: Body of PATCH /rest/v1/stores/{id}. Gson-serialised from UpdateStoreSyncTimeRequestDTO whose only field carries @SerializedName("store"). The legacy connectors' UpdateStoreRequestTO/StoreTO produce the same keys via Jackson.

UserMeResponse.description: Mapped into UserInfoDTO by Jackson; @JsonProperty names are the wire names. JPluger consumes seller_code, seller_id, base_currency, is_multiwarehousing, id and email.

id.description: SelluSeller user id, stored as User.sellusellerUserId.

seller_tag.description: Free-form; typed as Object in the DTO.
